pick.headline: Car bomb at Colombo bus station kills over 100
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of April 21, 1987, listed under Sri Lanka a 'huge' explosion ripping through Colombo's bus station, citing Delhi radio and AFP, with curfew details and a death toll reaching 110.
